description: This file defines an in-memory storage class for managing notes, including methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes. It uses a data class for note representation and maintains internal state for note records.

classes.name: NoteRecord
classes.description: Data class representing a note with id, title, content, creation, and update timestamps.

classes.name: InMemoryNoteStore
classes.description: Class providing an in-memory storage backend for notes with CRUD operations.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the in-memory store with an empty dictionary and starting id.

methods.name: List[NoteRecord] list_notes(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of all stored notes.

methods.name: NoteRecord create_note(self, title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Creates a new note with a unique id and timestamps, adds it to the store, and returns it.

methods.name: Optional[NoteRecord] get_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its id, or None if not found.

methods.name: Optional[NoteRecord] update_note(self, note_id: int, *, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Updates the specified fields of an existing note and updates its timestamp.

methods.name: bool delete_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by its id, returning True if successful.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^    def create_note(self, title: str, content: str) -> NoteRecord:$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^    def update_note(self, note_id: int, *, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] =/
ctags.signature: (self, note_id: int, *, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None)
